'''Marga Captison''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who was the wife of [[Dol Captison]], a public prosecutor. She was a spokeswoman for [[Imperial Relations]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]], but was secretly involved in the [[Bakuran resistance]], and died for it in [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]]. She was survived by her daughters, [[Gaeriel Captison|Gaeriel]] and [[Ylanda Captison|Ylanda]].<ref name="The Truce at Bakura Sourcebook" />
